scenes.title: Five Hundred Thousand Yen
scenes.summary: Muranishi pledges his house deed and stamps his personal seal to borrow five hundred thousand yen, then meets Toshi outside with their combined startup cash.

scenes.title: Ordering Every Kind
scenes.summary: At a Sapporo coffee shop, Toshi introduces magazine broker Chu, and Muranishi stuns both men by ordering every single title in stock as if opening a store.

scenes.title: Buying the Bookstore
scenes.summary: When struggling bookstore owner Kitamori refuses to carry Muranishi's magazines, Muranishi offers a bag of cash to buy the entire shop and hire Kitamori on the spot.

scenes.title: Lines Around the Block
scenes.summary: Two hungry patrol officers heading to lunch marvel at the packed customer line outside Hokudai Kanda Bookstore and discover new branches opening down the street.

scenes.title: Thirty-Eighth Branch Opening
scenes.summary: At the thirty-eighth Hokudai Kanda Bookstore branch, Muranishi cheers on newly appointed manager Tayama, who launches a thirty-percent opening discount.

scenes.title: Mori's Inspection
scenes.summary: Hokkaido Police detective Mori storms into the bookstore to check compliance, while Muranishi calmly argues every page meets the rules until Mori leaves with a warning.

scenes.title: Invitation from Ikezawa
scenes.summary: By the Sapporo riverbank, a friendly older stranger named Ikezawa chats about curiosity for hidden things before inviting Chairman Muranishi to accompany him.

scenes.title: Boys Arguing on the Corner
scenes.summary: Schoolboys bicker noisily on a street corner while Megumi and Akiko walk home nearby.

scenes.title: Walking Home with Akiko
scenes.summary: College friends Akiko and Megumi chat happily about Sister Tanaka and visiting Megumi's house today, until curious Megumi startles Akiko by speaking to boys on the street.

scenes.title: Strict Rules at Megumi's Home
scenes.summary: Megumi brings Akiko home, where her polite but controlling mother Kayo offers cake yet insists Akiko go straight to the washroom to wash her feet first.

scenes.title: Jazz, Freedom, and Order
scenes.summary: Poseidon president Ikezawa hosts Muranishi and Toshi at Reika's jazz lounge, comparing good business to jazz's balance of freedom and unspoken rules.

scenes.title: Three Hundred Million Yen
scenes.summary: Ikezawa sets down three hundred million yen as a deposit to buy all of Muranishi's stores and keep him inside Hokkaido, but Muranishi politely declines and walks out.

scenes.title: Turned Down by Publishers
scenes.summary: Determined to publish uncensored books like overseas editions, Muranishi is rejected by a cautious Sapporo editor and vows to Toshi to visit every company in Hokkaido.

scenes.title: Kawada's Studio Test
scenes.summary: Visiting studio producer Kawada, Muranishi hears how risky uncensored publishing is, then eagerly steps onto the set to rearrange chairs, borrow glasses, and direct.

scenes.title: Intense Studio Session
scenes.summary: Muranishi directs an energetic studio shoot while Kawada and the crew watch in astonishment.

scenes.title: Buying the Printing Factory
scenes.summary: Muranishi tells Kawada every work needs a story, then brings him to Yoshikawa Printing Factory, where Kawada calculates unit profits and Muranishi offers fifty million yen in cash.

scenes.title: Suzuran Sells Three Hundred Thousand
scenes.summary: Customers crowd the bookstore counter asking for the new edition Suzuran at fifteen thousand yen each, while Kaede reports three hundred thousand copies sold to a rueful Ikezawa.

scenes.title: Cooking on Ikezawa's Day Off
scenes.summary: At home on his day off, Ikezawa apologizes to his daughter Taeko and wife Yurie for work interruptions and serves a homemade meal that delights the family.

scenes.title: Warehouse Delivery and Patrol Car
scenes.summary: At the warehouse, Toshi scolds Furuya's crew over safety before Furuya apologizes and praises Muranishi's brisk sales; driving away to rock music, Toshi spots a patrol car.

scenes.title: Picture Books at the Checkpoint
scenes.summary: Stopped at a nighttime police checkpoint, Toshi panics when an officer checks the cargo, until calm Kawada presents cash-lined children's picture books and wins safe passage.

scenes.title: Wash Your Hands Again
scenes.summary: Kayo calls Megumi out of the bath for dinner and welcomes her compliment on the meal, then orders Megumi to go wash her hands all over again before eating.

scenes.title: Takei Arrives from Tokyo
scenes.summary: At Hokkaido Police headquarters, Detective Takei arrives from the Tokyo Metropolitan Police and scolds Detective Mori because Muranishi's books are now circulating in Tokyo.

scenes.title: Forty-Seven Stores and a Raid
scenes.summary: Muranishi toasts forty-seven branches in three months and aims for one hundred, unaware that Takei is raiding a delivery van; mid-party, Muranishi quietly leaves to go home.

scenes.title: Birthday Gift and Police at the Door
scenes.summary: Muranishi surprises Daisuke and Mayumi at home with a birthday remote-control car and promises to visit often, moments before Takei's detectives ring the doorbell and chase him.

scenes.title: Closing Theme Begins
scenes.summary: Closing music starts as detectives pursue Muranishi through the streets.

scenes.title: End Credits
scenes.summary: Closing credits roll to the end of Episode 2.
